_about: Allowlist for the Anchor meeting check. guard.py blocks every tool call that isn't allowed here. HubSpot is reached only through scripts/hubspot.py (which limits what it can write), Avoma only through scripts/avoma.py, and Google Calendar only through its connector's read tools. MCP tools are matched by the part after the server name (mcp__<server>__<tool>), because connector IDs differ between accounts.
